Information in contact and support.

A short explanation of what the website’s forms do.

What you send

Forms send your name, email, subject and message to Nortivo’s ticket system. Your email is used for confirmation, access to the ticket and replies. Do not include passwords, payment card information or other sensitive details.

Services used

Netlify serves the website and server functions. Supabase stores tickets and replies. Resend sends email. This website has no added analytics or marketing tracking.

Language and access

Your selected language is saved in this browser. On your first visit, Netlify’s approximate country information may select Norwegian in Norway; otherwise English. We do not use GPS. Temporary cookies verify access to a support ticket or the admin area.

Your records in the Arc app are separate from this website’s support data.

Have a question about your enquiry or your information? Create a support ticket.
